answer: Normal Pencil release already has a native Finish route. The native link modal accepts right-button/Escape Cancel, but the current barrel callback explicitly refuses a physical Pencil contact that is still down. Empty-space release can provide a fresh-link abandonment path through the native add/search popup, while detaching an existing input has different native graph/history semantics. No newly reproduced iPad defect or justified production/UI correction follows from this source-only audit. The narrow next increment is actual native/GHOST/WM characterization of socket acquisition and normal completion versus abandonment/Cancel.

workflow_contract.fact: After ring/HUD/navigation/paint/hardware exclusions, getScaledTouchPoint supplies the recognized current point. Ordinary handlePan Began resets cached translation, queues CURSOR_MOVE then LEFT_BUTTON_DOWN at that point, not the physical origin. The physical source origin is currently read for ring/HUD/paint/Knife admission; it is not a generic accepted Node press.

All evaluated stock node.link bindings require LEFTMOUSE CLICK_DRAG; Ctrl sets detach=true. Motion crosses the strict native tablet/mouse threshold, then WM reuses prev_press_xy for WM_event_drag_start_mval. node_link_invoke converts those press pixels with the current View2D and only adds the modal handler after native socket lookup succeeds. ED_operator_node_editable requires an editable current edittree. A native socket miss returns CANCELLED|PASS_THROUGH.

node_find_indicated_socket uses NODE_SOCKSIZE = 0.25*U.widget_unit and max_distance = NODE_SOCKSIZE + clamp(20/view2d_scale,5,30), with strict distance < max_distance. It chooses the nearest visible, unoccluded socket; ordinary node header exclusion, collapsed-output and multi-input rectangle cases remain native. This target is larger than the drawn socket radius. Threshold displacement alone therefore does not establish a miss. Adjacent sockets/zoom/header constraints require actual characterization.

Ordinary nonzero physical Pencil Changed keeps the existing paired PAN before CURSOR order. Current canonical stock-value selected View2D denial remains after genuine native poll and before allocation, and proves neither accepted DOWN nor Node ownership. Once native link modal exists, it consumes unmatched MOUSEPAN with RUNNING_MODAL; edge-pan helper processes only MOUSEMOVE. MOUSEMOVE updates the hovered socket and preview through actual node_link_find_socket.

Ordinary handlePan Ended queues LEFT_BUTTON_UP. Native modal-map translation maps LEFTMOUSE RELEASE with any modifiers to CONFIRM; node_link_modal calls the existing add/search branch and add_dragged_links_to_tree, returns FINISHED, then ordinary WM finished/history/handler cleanup runs. There is no missing Finish button demonstrated by this workflow.

Node Link Modal Map maps RIGHTMOUSE PRESS and ESC PRESS, any modifiers, to CANCEL. Actual native node_link_modal calls node_link_cancel then returns CANCELLED. That function deactivates tooltip, restores View2D edge-pan initial rectangle, resets linkdrag, clears highlight and tags/updates invariants; it does not itself re-add originals detached at invoke. WM CANCELLED frees the existing operator/handler rather than using the FINISHED/history path. Full graph/history outcomes need execution.

pencilInteractionDidTap returns before cancelPointerCapture or any packet when preferred tap is Ignore, current_pencil_touch exists, pan pencilContactDown is true, or hardware button state is pressed. GestureContact.down is true at physical Begin and ends on that identity after native touchesEnded/touchesCancelled superclass processing. With no down/hardware and no presented ring, admitted barrel queues native RMB Down then Up with NONE tablet data; a presented ring receives Home instead. Therefore native RMB Cancel exists, but one cannot claim barrel supplies Cancel during a normal held-tip link drag. After normal lift, queued LMB release normally finishes before a later barrel packet; no original-handler catch is guaranteed.

handleTap on Ended emits CURSOR_MOVE, LEFT_BUTTON_DOWN, LEFT_BUTTON_UP without an intervening post-press motion. No evaluated generated stock map binds node.link to a simple press, release or click. Native socket labels are tooltip labels; node.select remains selection, not link acquisition. This does not rule out a user-customized binding or explicit scripting.

Current stock space_node NODE_HT_header has no live NODE_OT_link Finish/Cancel action. Generic WM_window_modal_keymap_status_draw enumerates the actual modal map into uiTemplateStatusBarModalItem; its single-item path uiTemplateEventFromKeymapItem builds layout labels and separators for icons/text, not operator buttons or a Cancel callback. Native Cancel hint text is informational. This is a source observation, not a requirement to add UI.

native_empty_release_and_return.case: fresh regular output to empty space; no detached original
native_empty_release_and_return.source_expected: If the link endpoints remain detached and this is a supported non-custom tree/socket with no Swap, should_create_drag_link_search_menu is true. CONFIRM opens the native compatible-node search, then add_dragged_links_to_tree skips incomplete links and clears drag. Popup selection invokes creation; its execution callback immediately returns for a null item, and free only deletes search storage. Dismissing that popup is a supported candidate for abandoning a fresh proposed link without adding a new wire. It is FINISHED plus popup dismissal, not the native modal CANCEL status. Real popup dismissal and Undo/Redo have not run here.

native_empty_release_and_return.case: fresh ordinary output returned to the source point
native_empty_release_and_return.source_expected: There is no dedicated back-to-origin Cancel branch. When the final motion clears the opposite endpoint and no other eligible socket is found, this is the same detached-link/search case. Socket nearest-hit/self-node/previous-hover details can affect the endpoint; source location alone is not a universal cancellation receipt. Characterize after never hovering a target and after hovering one.

native_empty_release_and_return.case: existing single input link dragged from its input, then empty release
native_empty_release_and_return.source_expected: node_link_init copies and removes that original tree link. should_create_drag_link_search_menu explicitly returns false when start_socket is input and start_link_count > 0. Incomplete link is skipped on CONFIRM, so empty release can commit disconnection. It is not a safe generic abandon gesture for replacing an existing input.

native_empty_release_and_return.case: existing input link returned to its original input, then release
native_empty_release_and_return.source_expected: If actual motion selects that same original compatible input again, node_link_find_socket can restore the missing target endpoint; native CONFIRM can re-add the original connection. This is ordinary native completion and may have history effects, not native CANCEL. Actual graph equality, link order/multi-input order and Undo need a native run.

native_empty_release_and_return.case: native RMB/Esc while original link handler is live after detach
native_empty_release_and_return.source_expected: node_link_cancel clears drag and edge-pan state but does not restore detached original links itself. Do not assume native Cancel means application rollback of every detach; execute real baseline before proposing any correction or history policy.

positive_controls_supported_by_source: Regular editable Node WINDOW; exact stock link binding; recognized press remains in native source-socket admission; actual post-press MOUSEMOVE exceeds the native threshold: Node link can acquire its native handler.
Live native link plus target MOUSEMOVE followed by native LMB release enters CONFIRM and uses existing native insertion/duplicate/link-limit/Swap/multi-input handling.
Live native link plus native RMB press or Escape press enters actual native CANCEL, with existing WM cleanup. This is external/native input support, not proof that held-tip barrel can generate it.
Admitted no-tip-down barrel with no ring preserves native RMB Down/Up context behavior; presented ring preserves Home. Hardware, Ignore and live-contact vetoes remain.

Fresh unlinked regular socket empty release enters the native search path; dismissing without an item can abandon creation without a new Finish/Cancel surface. This needs actual native UI/history characterization.

Mixed/custom keymaps and event provenance retain native fallback; native View2D denial is not Node hit/press proof. Native Alt Swap, Ctrl Detach and multi-input branches remain source controls to preserve.
